# ops import

import tasks

## Usage

```
ops import
```

## Global Flags

- `-h, --help` — print help
- `-v, --verbose` — say more; repeat to count: -vvv
- `--color` `string` — when to color (default `auto`) (one of auto, always, never)

## Stdin

The tasks to import.

Reads a `yaml` document (`TaskList`) from stdin. Required.
